messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bulgarian, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bulgarian line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Vedi | imperative “see / behold” | **Виж** | “see / behold” | OK | | la | definite article (fem. sg.) | — (integrated in *зверото*) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | bestia | “the beast” (causal antecedent) | **зверото** | “the beast” | OK | | per | preposition “because of / for” | **заради** | “because of” | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun “which” (refers to *bestia*) | **което** | “which” | OK | | io | 1st‑person pronoun “I” (subject of *volsi*) | — (subject encoded in verb) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | mi | reflexive pronoun “myself” | **се** | “myself” (reflexive) | OK | | volsi | “turned” (past action of speaker) | **обърнах** | “I turned” | OK | | ; | end‑sentence punctuation | **;** | — | OK | | aiutami | imperative “help me” | **помогни ми** | “help me” | OK | | da | preposition “against” (opposition to *lei*) | **срещу** | “against” | OK | | lei | pronoun “her” (female entity) | **нея** | “her” | OK | | famoso | adjective “famous” | **известен** | “famous” | OK | | saggio | noun “sage” (addressed person) | **мъдрец** | “sage” | OK | | , | internal punctuation (kept in source) | **,** | — | OK | | ch'ella | causal clause introducer “for she …” (resultative) | **защото тя** | “because she” | **WRONG** (should preserve resultative “so … that …”, not causal “because”) | | mi | pronoun “my” (experiencer) | **ми** | “my” | OK | | fa | causative verb “makes” | **кара** | “makes” | OK | | tremar | infinitive “to tremble” | **да треперят** (split: *да* + *треперят*) | “to tremble” | OK | | le | definite article (fem. pl.) | — (integrated in *вените*) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | vene | noun “veins” | **вените** | “the veins” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **и** | “and” | OK | | i | definite article (masc. pl.) | — (integrated in *пулсите*) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | polsi | noun “pulses” | **пулсите** | “the pulses” | OK | | » | closing quotation mark (end punctuation) | **»** | — | OK | | . (extra period after the quote) | – | **.** (added erroneously) | – | **WRONG** (punctuation not present in source) |
---
### Issues Detected - **WRONG:** *ch'ella* rendered as “защото тя” (causal) instead of a resultative construction (e.g., “Така че тя…” or “Така, че тя…”). - **WRONG:** An extra period after the closing quotation mark on line 90, which does not appear in the source. - **UNNECESSARY:** Articles *la*, *io*, *le*, *i* are omitted in Bulgarian because definiteness is expressed by suffixes or is not required. - No **MISSING** or **GRAMMAR** agreement errors beyond the above points.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bulgarian script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bulgarian text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 88** - Original: Виж зверото заради което се обърнах; - Issue: none - Corrected: Виж зверото заради което се обърнах;
- **Line 89** - Original: помогни ми срещу нея, известен мъдрец, - Issue: none - Corrected: помогни ми срещу нея, известен мъдрец,
- **Line 90** - Original: защото тя кара вените и пулсите ми да треперят». - Issue: Wrong connective (causal “защото” instead of resultative) and extra period after the closing quotation mark. - Corrected: Така че тя кара вените и пулсите ми да треперят»
